figurative_meaning_bn: অতি প্রত্যুষে, ঝোঁকযুক্ত সকালবেলা, ভোর হতে-না-হতেই
figurative_meaning_en: Very early in the morning, at the break of dawn, right as the day begins
example_sentences_in_bangla: সক্কালবেলা বাজারে গিয়ে সবজি কিনে নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He got up at the crack of dawn and started working.
She went to the market bright and early to buy vegetables.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on early rising in rural Bengali life for agricultural or daily chores.
